info.description:
Front-end-facing API of the Boogle Engine Search Service: keyword search over
Project Gutenberg books with optional author, language and publication-year filters.
info.title: Boogle Engine Search API

get.description:
- **Provider:** Search Service
- **Intended consumer:** Front-end, to render the details of a book chosen from a search result.
- **Position in the workflow:** optional detail view after GET /search; it is one of the
variants of the front-end contract, not a separate route family.

Returns the metadata of a published book. A book that does not exist, or that is indexed
but still awaiting publication, is not visible and answers 404. The request has no body.

**Completion and publication.** Synchronous: the response always reflects the published
state of the datamart at the moment it is served.

**Idempotency and retries.** Read-only; repeating the request is always safe. A client
timeout of about 5 s is enough. Retry on timeouts and connection errors; a 404 does not
become 200 until the book is ingested and indexed.

200.description: The metadata of the published book

400.description: invalid_book_id: book_id is not a positive integer

404.description: book_not_found: no published book with that ID

500.description: internal_error: the datamart could not be read

get.description:
Returns one page of the books that contain every word of `q`, optionally narrowed by author,
language and original publication year. Filters can be combined and are joined with AND.
`q` may hold several words, matched with AND: a book is returned only when it contains all of them.
Words are split exactly like book text: runs of the letters a-z, case-insensitive, so digits, spaces
and punctuation separate words (`Moby-Dick` searches `moby` AND `dick`). Repeated words count once.
Stop words (the, and, of...), single letters and Roman numerals are never indexed and are ignored;
a `q` made only of them matches nothing and returns 200 with `results: []`.
`q` is rejected with 400 `invalid_parameter` when it contains no word at all (for example `1813` or `?!`)
or more than 10 distinct search words.
Empty filter values (for example `author=`) are treated as absent.
Only the filters that were applied are echoed in `filters`; the object is `{}` when none were sent.
Results are ordered by relevance, most relevant first: the summed frequency of the query words in
the book, with ties broken by ascending `book_id`.
`total` counts every match, while `results` holds at most `limit` books starting at `offset`.
A valid query without matches, or an `offset` past the last match, returns 200 with `results: []`.

parameters.description: One or more keywords, all of which a book must contain (AND); surrounding spaces are ignored
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the author name
parameters.name: author

parameters.description: ISO 639 language code, case-insensitive exact match (en, es, fr...)
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Number of matches to skip before the first result
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Maximum number of results in the page
parameters.name: limit

400.description: q is missing (missing_parameter); q has no word or more than 10 distinct words, or another parameter is malformed (invalid_parameter)

get.description:
- **Provider:** Search Service
- **Intended consumer:** Front-end, to populate the language and year choices of its search form.

Returns the distinct ISO 639 language codes (a book written in several languages contributes
every one of its codes) and the distinct original publication years of the published books,
both sorted ascending. Books without a known language or year do not contribute a value, so
every returned value can be sent back to GET /search and actually match results. The request
has no body; the slices are empty arrays, never null, when no books are published.

**Completion and publication.** Synchronous and read-only; it reflects the published state
of the datamart when it is served.

**Idempotency and retries.** Safe to repeat; retry on timeouts and connection errors.

200.description: Distinct filter values of the published books

500.description: internal_error: the datamart could not be read

language.description: ISO 639 code; books written in several languages list them comma-separated ("en,fr")

year.description: Original publication year, or 0 when unknown

message.example: query parameter "limit" must be an integer between 1 and 100

languages.description: ISO 639 language codes of the published books, sorted ascending; never null

years.description: Original publication years of the published books, sorted ascending; never null

filters.description: Filters that were applied; absent filters are omitted

query.description: Keywords exactly as sent in q, without surrounding spaces

results.description: Books of the requested page; never null

total.description: Number of matches across all pages

tags.description: Keyword search with metadata filters and pagination
tags.name: search
